subject: Physics
title: Projectile Motion Equations
description: Trajectory equation: $y = x \tan\theta - \frac{g x^2}{2 u^2 \cos^2\theta}$. Angle for maximum range $R_{\max} = \frac{u^2}{g}$ is $\theta = 45^\circ$.
variables: $u$: initial velocity, $\theta$: projection angle with horizontal, $g$: acceleration due to gravity
examTip: Two angles $\theta$ and $90^\circ - \theta$ give the exact same range $R$, but different maximum heights $H_1, H_2$ where $R = 4\sqrt{H_1 H_2}$.

subject: Physics
title: Parallel & Perpendicular Axis Theorems
formula: I = I_{\text{cm}} + M d^2, \qquad I_z = I_x + I_y
description: Parallel axis theorem applies to any rigid 3D body. Perpendicular axis theorem ($I_z = I_x + I_y$) ONLY applies to planar 2D laminar objects.
variables: $I_{\text{cm}}$: moment of inertia about CM axis, $d$: distance between parallel axes
examTip: For a ring: $I_{\text{cm}} = MR^2$. For a disc: $I_{\text{cm}} = \frac{1}{2}MR^2$. For a solid sphere: $I_{\text{cm}} = \frac{2}{5}MR^2$.

subject: Physics
title: Gauss's Law & Electric Potential
description: Electric field due to point charge $E = \frac{k Q}{r^2}$. Potential due to point charge $V = \frac{k Q}{r}$. Electric dipole potential $V = \frac{k p \cos\theta}{r^2}$.
variables: $Q_{\text{encl}}$: enclosed charge, $\varepsilon_0$: permittivity of free space
examTip: Inside a uniformly charged solid non-conducting sphere, field increases linearly $E \propto r$, while outside it drops off $E \propto 1/r^2$.

subject: Chemistry
title: Nernst Equation for Cell EMF
formula: E_{\text{cell}} = E^\circ_{\text{cell}} - \frac{2.303 RT}{n F} \log_{10} Q = E^\circ_{\text{cell}} - \frac{0.0591}{n} \log_{10} \frac{[\text{Products}]}{[\text{Reactants}]}
description: Used to calculate non-standard reduction potential or cell EMF under arbitrary concentrations at $298\text{ K}$. At equilibrium, $E_{\text{cell}} = 0 \implies E^\circ = \frac{0.0591}{n} \log K_{eq}$.
variables: $n$: electrons transferred, $Q$: reaction quotient, $E^\circ$: standard cell potential
examTip: Always balance the overall redox equation first to get the correct exponent powers for concentrations in $Q$.

subject: Chemistry
title: Reimer-Tiemann & Kolbe's Reaction
description: Reimer-Tiemann converts phenol to salicylaldehyde via dichlorocarbene intermediate $: \text{CCl}_2$. Kolbe's reaction converts phenol with $\text{NaOH} + \text{CO}_2 \xrightarrow{\text{H}^+} \text{Salicylic acid}$.
examTip: Remember that the active electrophile in Reimer-Tiemann is neutral dichlorocarbene ($:\text{CCl}_2$), NOT a carbocation!

subject: Chemistry
title: Crystal Field Splitting Energy (CFSE)
description: Octahedral splitting $\Delta_o$. Strong field ligands (e.g. $\text{CN}^-, \text{CO}, \text{en}$) cause pairing ($P < \Delta_o$), resulting in low spin complexes.
variables: $n_{t_{2g}}$: electrons in $t_{2g}$ orbitals, $n_{e_g}$: electrons in $e_g$ orbitals
examTip: Spectrochemical series: $\text{I}^- < \text{Br}^- < \text{Cl}^- < \text{F}^- < \text{OH}^- < \text{H}_2\text{O} < \text{NH}_3 < \text{en} < \text{CN}^- < \text{CO}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Integration by Parts & Special Standard Forms
formula: \int u \, dv = u v - \int v \, du, \qquad \int e^x \left[f(x) + f'(x)\right] dx = e^x f(x) + C
description: Choose $u$ using the ILATE rule (Inverse trig, Logarithmic, Algebraic, Trigonometric, Exponential).
examTip: Whenever you see $\int e^x (...)$, immediately check if the integrand can be written in the form $f(x) + f'(x)$ to solve in 5 seconds!

subject: Mathematics
title: De Moivre's Theorem & Cube Roots of Unity
description: Euler's formula: $e^{i\theta} = \cos \theta + i \sin \theta$. Cube roots of unity $\omega = e^{i 2\pi/3} = -\frac{1}{2} + i\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$.
examTip: $1 + \omega^k + \omega^{2k} = 3$ if $k$ is a multiple of 3, and $0$ otherwise.

subject: Mathematics
title: Shortest Distance Between Skew Lines
description: For lines $\vec{r} = \vec{a}_1 + \lambda \vec{b}_1$ and $\vec{r} = \vec{a}_2 + \mu \vec{b}_2$. If lines intersect, shortest distance $d = 0$.
examTip: If lines are parallel (\vec{b}_1 = \vec{b}_2 = \vec{b}), the distance formula simplifies to $d = \frac{|(\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1) \times \vec{b}|}{|\vec{b}|}$.

subject: Chemistry
title: Potassium Permanganate (\text{KMnO}_4)
description: Function: Strong Oxidizing Agent. Transformations: 1^\circ \text{ Alcohols} \to \text{Carboxylic Acids} \quad | \quad 2^\circ \text{ Alcohols} \to \text{Ketones} \quad | \quad \text{Alkylbenzenes} \to \text{Benzoic Acid}. Conditions: Acidic (\text{H}^+), Basic (\text{OH}^-), or Neutral. Cold dilute alkaline \text{KMnO}_4 for syn-hydroxylation..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Decolorizes purple \text{KMnO}_4 solution (Baeyer's test for unsaturation).

subject: Chemistry
title: Potassium Dichromate (\text{K}_2\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7 / \text{H}_2\text{SO}_4)
formula: 3 R\text{-}CH_2OH + 2 K_2Cr_2O_7 + 8 H_2SO_4 \to 3 R\text{-}COOH + 2 Cr_2(SO_4)_3 \text{ (Green)} + 2 K_2SO_4 + 11 H_2O
description: Function: Strong Oxidizing Agent. Transformations: 1^\circ \text{ Alcohols} \to \text{Carboxylic Acids} \quad | \quad 2^\circ \text{ Alcohols} \to \text{Ketones}. Conditions: Acidic medium (conc. \text{H}_2\text{SO}_4), heat..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Orange \text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-} turns green \text{Cr}^{3+} upon reduction.

subject: Chemistry
title: Pyridinium Chlorochromate (PCC) (\text{C}_5\text{H}_5\text{NH}^+ \text{CrO}_3\text{Cl}^-)
description: Function: Mild Selective Oxidizing Agent. Transformations: 1^\circ \text{ Alcohols} \to \text{Aldehydes (Stops at Aldehyde)} \quad | \quad 2^\circ \text{ Alcohols} \to \text{Ketones}. Conditions: Anhydrous \text{CH}_2\text{Cl}_2 (dichloromethane) solvent..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Does NOT oxidize aldehydes further to carboxylic acids; leaves C=C double bonds intact.

subject: Chemistry
title: Lithium Aluminium Hydride (LAH) (\text{LiAlH}_4)
description: Function: Strong Nucleophilic Reducing Agent. Transformations: \text{Carboxylic Acids, Esters, Aldehydes, Ketones} \to \text{Alcohols} \quad | \quad \text{Amides, Nitriles} \to \text{Primary Amines}. Conditions: Dry ether or THF solvent followed by acidic aqueous workup (H_3O^+)..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Reacts violently with water/moisture releasing H_2 gas. Cannot reduce isolated C=C double bonds.

subject: Chemistry
title: Sodium Borohydride (\text{NaBH}_4)
description: Function: Mild Selective Reducing Agent. Transformations: \text{Aldehydes} \to 1^\circ \text{ Alcohols} \quad | \quad \text{Ketones} \to 2^\circ \text{ Alcohols} \quad | \quad \text{Acyl Chlorides} \to 1^\circ \text{ Alcohols}. Conditions: Protic solvents (methanol, ethanol, or water)..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Safer than LAH; does NOT reduce esters, carboxylic acids, or amides.

subject: Chemistry
title: Ozone with Zinc / Water (\text{O}_3 / \text{Zn}, \text{H}_2\text{O})
formula: R\text{-}CH=CH\text{-}R' \xrightarrow[\text{2. Zn / } H_2O]{\text{1. } O_3} R\text{-}CHO + R'\text{-}CHO
description: Function: Reductive Cleavage of C=C Double/Triple Bonds. Transformations: \text{Alkenes } (R\text{-}CH=CH\text{-}R') \to \text{Aldehydes / Ketones}. Conditions: Low temp (-78^\circ\text{C} in \text{CH}_2\text{Cl}_2) followed by \text{Zn}/\text{H}_2\text{O} reduction..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Zinc prevents further oxidation of aldehydes to carboxylic acids.

subject: Chemistry
title: Thionyl Chloride (\text{SOCl}_2)
description: Function: Chlorinating Agent. Transformations: R\text{-}OH \to R\text{-}Cl \quad | \quad R\text{-}COOH \to R\text{-}COCl. Conditions: Reflux, often in presence of pyridine..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Byproducts \text{SO}_2(g) and \text{HCl}(g) escape, leaving pure product.

subject: Chemistry
title: Grignard Reagent (R\text{-}\text{MgX})
formula: R\text{-}MgX + HCHO \xrightarrow[\text{2. } H_3O^+]{\text{1. Dry Ether}} R\text{-}CH_2OH
description: Function: Strong Carbon Nucleophile & Base. Transformations: \text{Formaldehyde} \to 1^\circ \text{ Alcohol} \quad | \quad \text{Aldehydes} \to 2^\circ \text{ Alcohol} \quad | \quad \text{Ketones} \to 3^\circ \text{ Alcohol} \quad | \quad \text{CO}_2 \to \text{Carboxylic Acid}. Conditions: Dry ether or THF solvent, followed by H_3O^+ hydrolysis..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Protic sources (water, alcohol) destroy Grignard reagents to yield alkanes (R\text{-}H).

subject: Chemistry
title: Tollens' Reagent ([\text{Ag(NH}_3)_2]^+\text{OH}^-)
formula: R\text{-}CHO + 2[Ag(NH_3)_2]^+ + 3 OH^- \to R\text{-}COO^- + 2 Ag\downarrow \text{ (Mirror)} + 4 NH_3 + 2 H_2O
description: Function: Mild Selective Oxidizing Agent. Transformations: \text{Aliphatic & Aromatic Aldehydes} \to \text{Carboxylate Ions} + \text{Ag Mirror (Silver)}. Conditions: Warm alkaline solution..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Distinguishes aldehydes (positive silver mirror) from ketones (negative test).

subject: Chemistry
title: Fehling's Solution (\text{Fehling A (CuSO}_4) + \text{Fehling B (Rochelle Salt + NaOH)})
formula: R\text{-}CHO + 2 Cu^{2+} + 5 OH^- \to R\text{-}COO^- + Cu_2O\downarrow \text{ (Red ppt)} + 3 H_2O
description: Function: Mild Oxidizing Agent. Transformations: \text{Aliphatic Aldehydes} \to \text{Carboxylate Ions} + \text{Cu}_2\text{O} \text{ (Red ppt)}. Conditions: Heat in alkaline medium..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Aromatic aldehydes (benzaldehyde) do NOT reduce Fehling's solution.

subject: Chemistry
title: Clemmensen Reduction Reagent (\text{Zn(Hg)} / \text{conc. HCl})
description: Function: Deoxygenation of Carbonyl Group to Methylene. Transformations: \text{Carbonyl Group } (C=O) \to \text{Methylene Group } (-CH_2-). Conditions: Strongly acidic conditions, reflux..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Unsuitable for acid-sensitive compounds containing OH, ester, or ether groups.

subject: Chemistry
title: Wolff-Kishner Reduction Reagent (\text{NH}_2\text{NH}_2 / \text{KOH}, \text{Ethylene Glycol})
description: Function: Deoxygenation of Carbonyl Group to Methylene. Transformations: \text{Carbonyl Group } (C=O) \to \text{Methylene Group } (-CH_2-) + N_2\uparrow. Conditions: Strongly basic medium, high temperature (180-200^\circ\text{C})..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Ideal for acid-sensitive compounds; unsuitable for base-sensitive groups.

subject: Chemistry
title: Lucas Reagent (\text{Anhydrous ZnCl}_2 + \text{conc. HCl})
description: Function: Classification of Alcohols. Transformations: 1^\circ, 2^\circ, 3^\circ \text{ Alcohols} \to \text{Insoluble Alkyl Chlorides } (R\text{-}Cl). Conditions: Room temperature..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: 3^\circ alcohols give immediate turbidity; 2^\circ within 5 min; 1^\circ requires heat.

subject: Chemistry
title: Hinsberg Reagent (\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{SO}_2\text{Cl})
description: Function: Distinction & Separation of Amines. Transformations: 1^\circ \text{ Amine} \to \text{Soluble in alkali} \quad | \quad 2^\circ \text{ Amine} \to \text{Insoluble in alkali} \quad | \quad 3^\circ \text{ Amine} \to \text{No reaction}. Conditions: Aqueous \text{NaOH} medium..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Distinguishes primary, secondary, and tertiary amines.

subject: Chemistry
title: Lindlar's Catalyst (\text{H}_2 / \text{Pd-CaCO}_3 \text{ poisoned with quinoline})
description: Function: Stereoselective Partial Hydrogenation of Alkynes. Transformations: \text{Alkynes } (R\text{-}C\equiv C\text{-}R') \to \text{cis-Alkenes / (Z)-Alkenes}. Conditions: Room temperature under hydrogen gas pressure..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Prevents complete reduction to alkanes.

subject: Chemistry
title: Birch Reduction Reagents (\text{Na} / \text{liquid NH}_3 + \text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{OH})
description: Function: Stereoselective Partial Reduction. Transformations: \text{Non-terminal Alkynes} \to \text{trans-Alkenes / (E)-Alkenes} \quad | \quad \text{Benzene} \to 1,4\text{-Cyclohexadiene}. Conditions: Low temperature (-33^\circ\text{C})..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Solvated electrons give trans-alkene geometry.

subject: Chemistry
title: Anhydrous Aluminium Chloride (\text{Anhydrous AlCl}_3)
description: Function: Strong Lewis Acid Catalyst. Transformations: \text{Friedel-Crafts Alkylation } (R\text{-}Cl) \text{ and Acylation } (R\text{-}COCl). Conditions: Anhydrous medium..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Forms carbocation electrophiles from alkyl/acyl halides.

subject: Chemistry
title: Alcoholic KOH vs Aqueous KOH (\text{alc. KOH vs aq. KOH})
description: Function: Elimination (E2) vs Nucleophilic Substitution (S_N2). Transformations: \text{Alc. KOH: Alkyl Halides } \to \text{Alkenes} \quad | \quad \text{Aq. KOH: Alkyl Halides } \to \text{Alcohols}. Conditions: Heat for alc. KOH; room temp for aq. KOH..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Alc. KOH contains ethoxide ion (\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{O}^-), promoting elimination.

subject: Chemistry
title: Sodamide (\text{NaNH}_2)
formula: R\text{-}C\equiv CH + NaNH_2 \xrightarrow{\text{Liq. } NH_3} R\text{-}C\equiv C^- Na^+ + NH_3
description: Function: Superbase. Transformations: \text{Terminal Alkynes} \to \text{Acetylide Ions } (R\text{-}C\equiv C^- \text{Na}^+) \quad | \quad \text{Dihalides} \to \text{Alkynes}. Conditions: Liquid ammonia solvent (-33^\circ\text{C})..
examTip: Selectivity / Pro Tip: Much stronger base than \text{KOH} or \text{NaOH}.

subject: Chemistry
title: Wurtz Reaction
description: Reaction Type: Free Radical Coupling. Equation: $$2 R\text{-}X + 2\text{Na} \xrightarrow{\text{Dry Ether}} R\text{-}R + 2\text{NaX}$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Used to prepare symmetrical alkanes with even carbon count.

subject: Chemistry
title: Finkelstein Reaction
description: Reaction Type: S_N2 Halogen Exchange. Equation: $$R\text{-}Cl/Br + \text{NaI} \xrightarrow{\text{Dry Acetone}} R\text{-}I + \text{NaCl/NaBr}\downarrow$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Precipitation of NaCl/NaBr drives reaction forward.

subject: Chemistry
title: Swarts Reaction
description: Reaction Type: Fluorination Halogen Exchange. Equation: $$R\text{-}Cl/Br + \text{AgF} \xrightarrow{\Delta} R\text{-}F + \text{AgCl}\downarrow$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Best method for preparing alkyl fluorides.

subject: Chemistry
title: Williamson Ether Synthesis
description: Reaction Type: S_N2 Nucleophilic Substitution. Equation: $$R\text{-}X (1^\circ) + R'\text{-}O^-\text{Na}^+ \to R\text{-}O\text{-}R' + \text{NaX}$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: 3° alkyl halides yield alkenes via E2 elimination.

subject: Chemistry
title: Kolbe's Reaction
description: Reaction Type: Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution. Equation: $$\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{ONa} + \text{CO}_2 \xrightarrow{400\text{K, 4-7atm}} \text{Salicylic Acid}$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Industrial route for Salicylic Acid (precursor to Aspirin).

subject: Chemistry
title: Reimer-Tiemann Reaction
description: Reaction Type: Carbene Addition / Substitution. Equation: $$\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{OH} + \text{CHCl}_3 + \text{NaOH} \to \text{Salicylaldehyde}$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Active electrophile is neutral dichlorocarbene (:CCl_2).

subject: Chemistry
title: Aldol Condensation
description: Reaction Type: Nucleophilic Addition / Elimination. Equation: $$2 CH_3CHO \xrightarrow{\text{dil. NaOH}} \text{Aldol} \xrightarrow{\Delta} \text{Crotonaldehyde}$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Requires alpha-hydrogen atom on carbonyl.

subject: Chemistry
title: Cannizzaro Reaction
description: Reaction Type: Disproportionation Redox. Equation: $$2 HCHO + \text{conc. NaOH} \to CH_3OH + HCOONa$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Occurs in aldehydes LACKING alpha-hydrogen atoms.

subject: Chemistry
title: Clemmensen Reduction
description: Reaction Type: Acidic Deoxygenation. Equation: $$>C=O \xrightarrow{\text{Zn(Hg)} / \text{conc. HCl}} >CH_2$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Converts carbonyl to methylene in acidic medium.

subject: Chemistry
title: Wolff-Kishner Reduction
description: Reaction Type: Basic Deoxygenation. Equation: $$>C=O \xrightarrow{\text{NH}_2\text{NH}_2 / \text{KOH, glycol}} >CH_2 + N_2\uparrow$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Converts carbonyl to methylene in basic medium.

subject: Chemistry
title: Iodoform Reaction
description: Reaction Type: Halogenation / Base-cleavage. Equation: $$R\text{-}COCH_3 + 3 I_2 + 4 NaOH \to R\text{-}COONa + CHI_3\downarrow \text{ (Yellow)}$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Identifies CH3C=O or CH3CH(OH) group via yellow CHI3 ppt.

subject: Chemistry
title: Hell-Volhard-Zelinsky (HVZ)
description: Reaction Type: Alpha-Halogenation. Equation: $$R\text{-}CH_2\text{-}COOH + X_2 \xrightarrow{\text{Red P}} R\text{-}CH(X)\text{-}COOH$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Specific alpha-halogenation of carboxylic acids.

subject: Chemistry
title: Gabriel Phthalimide Synthesis
description: Reaction Type: S_N2 Nucleophilic Substitution. Equation: $$\text{Phthalimide} \xrightarrow{\text{KOH, R-X, NaOH}} R\text{-}NH_2 (1^\circ)$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Yields pure 1° aliphatic amines ONLY (aromatic amines fail).

subject: Chemistry
title: Hofmann Bromamide Degradation
formula: R\text{-}CONH_2 + Br_2 + 4 NaOH \to R\text{-}NH_2 + Na_2CO_3 + 2 NaBr
description: Reaction Type: Intramolecular Rearrangement. Equation: $$R\text{-}CONH_2 + Br_2 + 4 NaOH \to R\text{-}NH_2 + Na_2CO_3 + 2 NaBr$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Stepping-down reaction: decreases carbon chain length by 1.

subject: Chemistry
title: Carbylamine Reaction
description: Reaction Type: Electrophilic Addition. Equation: $$R\text{-}NH_2 + CHCl_3 + 3 \text{alc. KOH} \to R\text{-}NC \text{ (Foul odor)}$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Specific test for primary amines (foul smelling isocyanide).

subject: Chemistry
title: Sandmeyer Reaction
description: Reaction Type: Radical Substitution. Equation: $$Ar\text{-}N_2^+ Cl^- \xrightarrow{\text{Cu}_2\text{Cl}_2 / \text{HCl}} Ar\text{-}Cl + N_2\uparrow$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Prepares aryl halides from diazonium salts.

subject: Chemistry
title: Azo Coupling Reaction
description: Reaction Type: Electrophilic Substitution. Equation: $$C_6H_5N_2^+ Cl^- + C_6H_5OH \to p\text{-}\text{HO-C}_6\text{H}_4\text{-N=N-C}_6\text{H}_5 \text{ (Orange Dye)}$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Dye test for aromatic diazonium salts with phenol/aniline.

subject: Chemistry
title: Etard Reaction
description: Reaction Type: Controlled Side-Chain Oxidation. Equation: $$C_6H_5CH_3 + 2 CrO_2Cl_2 \xrightarrow{\text{CS}_2, H_3O^+} C_6H_5CHO$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Converts toluene specifically to benzaldehyde.

subject: Chemistry
title: Rosenmund Reduction
description: Reaction Type: Selective Hydrogenation. Equation: $$R\text{-}COCl + H_2 \xrightarrow{\text{Pd-BaSO}_4 / \text{Sulfur}} R\text{-}CHO$$
examTip: JEE Key Pro Tip: Poisoned catalyst stops reduction at aldehyde stage.

subject: Chemistry
title: Structure: Methane (\text{CH}_4)
description: Properties: Non-polar molecule, regular tetrahedral symmetry.
variables: Central Atom: Lone Pairs = 0, Oxidation State = -4
examTip: VSEPR Geometry: Tetrahedral (sp^3) with 0 lone pair(s).

subject: Chemistry
title: Structure: Ammonia (\text{NH}_3)
description: Properties: Lewis base due to 1 lone pair on N; distorted from tetrahedral 109.5°.
variables: Central Atom: Lone Pairs = 1, Oxidation State = -3
examTip: VSEPR Geometry: Trigonal Pyramidal (sp^3) with 1 lone pair(s).

subject: Chemistry
title: Structure: Water (\text{H}_2\text{O})
description: Properties: Highly polar, extensive intermolecular hydrogen bonding.
variables: Central Atom: Lone Pairs = 2, Oxidation State = -2
examTip: VSEPR Geometry: Bent / V-shaped (sp^3) with 2 lone pair(s).

subject: Chemistry
title: Structure: Boron Trifluoride (\text{BF}_3)
description: Properties: Incomplete octet (6 valence electrons around B); strong Lewis acid.
variables: Central Atom: Lone Pairs = 0, Oxidation State = +3
examTip: VSEPR Geometry: Trigonal Planar (sp^2) with 0 lone pair(s).

subject: Chemistry
title: Structure: Phosphorus Pentachloride (\text{PCl}_5)
description: Properties: 2 axial bonds are longer and weaker than 3 equatorial bonds.
variables: Central Atom: Lone Pairs = 0, Oxidation State = +5
examTip: VSEPR Geometry: Trigonal Bipyramidal (sp^3d) with 0 lone pair(s).

subject: Chemistry
title: Structure: Sulfur Hexafluoride (\text{SF}_6)
description: Properties: Extremely inert, hypervalent molecule (12 electrons around S).
variables: Central Atom: Lone Pairs = 0, Oxidation State = +6
examTip: VSEPR Geometry: Octahedral (sp^3d^2) with 0 lone pair(s).

subject: Chemistry
title: Structure: Xenon Difluoride (\text{XeF}_2)
description: Properties: 3 lone pairs occupy equatorial positions at 120° to minimize repulsion.
variables: Central Atom: Lone Pairs = 3, Oxidation State = +2
examTip: VSEPR Geometry: Linear (sp^3d) with 3 lone pair(s).

subject: Chemistry
title: Structure: Xenon Tetrafluoride (\text{XeF}_4)
description: Properties: 2 lone pairs occupy trans axial positions; 4 F atoms in square plane.
variables: Central Atom: Lone Pairs = 2, Oxidation State = +4
examTip: VSEPR Geometry: Square Planar (sp^3d^2) with 2 lone pair(s).

subject: Chemistry
title: Structure: Xenon Hexafluoride (\text{XeF}_6)
description: Properties: Stereochemically active single lone pair distorts octahedral symmetry.
variables: Central Atom: Lone Pairs = 1, Oxidation State = +6
examTip: VSEPR Geometry: Distorted Octahedral (sp^3d^3) with 1 lone pair(s).

subject: Chemistry
title: Test: Bromine Water Test (Unsaturation (Alkenes / Alkynes))
description: Observation: Decolorization of reddish-brown bromine solution. | Reagent: \text{Br}_2 / \text{CCl}_4
examTip: Inference: Presence of C=C or C\equiv C unsaturation.

subject: Chemistry
title: Test: Baeyer's Test (Unsaturation (Alkenes / Alkynes))
description: Observation: Decolorization of purple \text{KMnO}_4 with brown ppt of \text{MnO}_2. | Reagent: Cold dilute alkaline \text{KMnO}_4 (1\%)
examTip: Inference: Presence of unsaturation (syn-1,2-diol formed).

subject: Chemistry
title: Test: Ceric Ammonium Nitrate Test (Alcoholic Group (-OH))
description: Observation: Appearance of red or pink color solution. | Reagent: (\text{NH}_4)_2\text{Ce(NO}_3)_6
examTip: Inference: Presence of alcoholic hydroxyl group.

subject: Chemistry
title: Test: Neutral Ferric Chloride Test (Phenolic Group (Ar-OH))
description: Observation: Formation of violet, blue, or green coloration. | Reagent: Freshly prepared neutral \text{FeCl}_3 solution
examTip: Inference: Presence of phenolic group.

subject: Chemistry
title: Test: 2,4-DNP Test (Brady's Test) (Carbonyl Group (C=O))
description: Observation: Yellow, orange, or red crystalline precipitate. | Reagent: 2,4-Dinitrophenylhydrazine
examTip: Inference: Presence of aldehyde or ketone carbonyl group.

subject: Chemistry
title: Test: Tollens' Silver Mirror Test (Aldehydes (-CHO))
description: Observation: Formation of shiny silver mirror on test-tube wall. | Reagent: [\text{Ag(NH}_3)_2]^+\text{OH}^-
examTip: Inference: Presence of aldehyde group.

subject: Chemistry
title: Test: Fehling's Test (Aliphatic Aldehydes)
description: Observation: Reddish-brown precipitate of \text{Cu}_2\text{O}. | Reagent: \text{Fehling A (CuSO}_4) + \text{Fehling B (Rochelle Salt + NaOH)}
examTip: Inference: Presence of aliphatic aldehyde.

subject: Chemistry
title: Test: Iodoform Test (Methyl Ketones / Ethanol)
description: Observation: Yellow crystalline ppt of Iodoform (\text{CHI}_3) with antiseptic odor. | Reagent: \text{I}_2 + \text{NaOH (NaOI)}
examTip: Inference: Presence of \text{CH}_3\text{CO}- or \text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)}- group.

subject: Chemistry
title: Test: Sodium Bicarbonate Test (Carboxylic Acid (-COOH))
description: Observation: Brisk effervescence of \text{CO}_2 gas. | Reagent: Saturated aqueous \text{NaHCO}_3 solution
examTip: Inference: Presence of carboxylic acid group.

subject: Chemistry

subject: Mathematics
title: Sets & Power Set Cardinality
description: Power set contains all subsets. Number of proper subsets = $2^n - 1$.
variables: $n = n(A)$: number of elements in set A
examTip: Number of subsets with at least $k$ elements = $\sum_{r=k}^n {}^n C_r$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Inclusion-Exclusion Principle
formula: n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)
description: Cardinality of union of sets. For 3 sets: $n(A \cup B \cup C) = \sum n(A) - \sum n(A \cap B) + n(A \cap B \cap C)$.
examTip: Disjoint sets: $n(A \cap B) = 0 \implies n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B)$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Cartesian Product & Total Relations
formula: n(A \times B) = m \cdot n, \quad \text{Total Relations} = 2^{m n}
description: Cartesian product $A \times B = \{(a,b) : a \in A, b \in B\}$. Subset of $A \times B$ defines a relation.
examTip: Number of non-empty relations = $2^{mn} - 1$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Types of Relations
formula: R \text{ Reflexive } \iff (a,a) \in R, \quad R \text{ Symmetric } \iff (a,b) \in R \implies (b,a) \in R
description: Equivalence relation is Reflexive, Symmetric, and Transitive. Transitive: $(a,b),(b,c) \in R \implies (a,c) \in R$.
examTip: Reflexive relations count = $2^{n(n-1)}$; Symmetric relations count = $2^{n(n+1)/2}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Principle of Mathematical Induction & Summations
description: Base step $P(1)$, assume $P(k)$, prove $P(k+1)$. Divisibility: $a^n - b^n$ is always divisible by $a-b$.
examTip: Bernoulli's Inequality: $(1+x)^n \ge 1 + nx$ for $x > -1$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Matrix Operations & Transpose Properties
description: Symmetric: $A^T = A$. Skew-Symmetric: $A^T = -A$. Every square matrix $A = \frac{1}{2}(A+A^T) + \frac{1}{2}(A-A^T)$.
examTip: Diagonal elements of skew-symmetric matrix are always ZERO.

subject: Mathematics
title: Adjoint Identities & Cramer's Rule
description: Cramer's rule: $x = \Delta_x / \Delta, y = \Delta_y / \Delta, z = \Delta_z / \Delta$. Unique solution iff $\Delta \neq 0$.
variables: |A|: determinant of n x n matrix A
examTip: Vandermonde determinant $|1, 1, 1; a, b, c; a^2, b^2, c^2| = (a-b)(b-c)(c-a)$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Modulus, Argument & De Moivre's Theorem
description: Euler form $z = r e^{i\theta}$. Cube roots of unity: $1 + \omega + \omega^2 = 0, \omega^3 = 1$.
examTip: Square root of complex number $\sqrt{x+iy} = \pm [ \sqrt{(|z|+x)/2} + i \text{sgn}(y) \sqrt{(|z|-x)/2} ]$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Roots, Discriminant & Vieta's Formulas
description: Discriminant $D = b^2 - 4ac$. Difference of roots $|\alpha - \beta| = \sqrt{D}/|a|$. Vertex at $x = -b/(2a), y = -D/(4a)$.
examTip: Common root of two quadratics: $(a_1 c_2 - a_2 c_1)^2 = (a_1 b_2 - a_2 b_1)(b_1 c_2 - b_2 c_1)$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Arrangements, Selections & Derangements
description: Pascal identity: ${}^n C_r + {}^n C_{r-1} = {}^{n+1} C_r$. Stars and bars: ${}^{n+r-1} C_{r-1}$. Polygon diagonals: $n(n-3)/2$.
examTip: Number of ways to divide $2n$ distinct items into 2 equal unlabeled groups = $(2n)! / (2! (n!)^2)$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Expansion, General Term & Coefficient Sums
formula: (x+y)^n = \sum_{r=0}^n {}^n C_r x^{n-r} y^r, \quad T_{r+1} = {}^n C_r x^{n-r} y^r
description: Sum of coefficients $C_0 + C_1 + ... + C_n = 2^n$. Sum of squares $C_0^2 + C_1^2 + ... + C_n^2 = {}^{2n} C_n$.
examTip: Multinomial terms count in $(x_1 + ... + x_k)^n$ is ${}^{n+k-1} C_{k-1}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: AP, GP, HP & AGP Summations
description: AM-GM-HM Inequality: $A \ge G \ge H \implies \frac{a+b}{2} \ge \sqrt{ab} \ge \frac{2ab}{a+b}$. GM squared: $G^2 = A \cdot H$.
variables: a: first term, d: common diff, r: common ratio
examTip: Infinite AGP sum: $S_\infty = \frac{a}{1-r} + \frac{d r}{(1-r)^2}$ for $|r| < 1$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Line Forms, Distance & Perpendiculars
formula: y - y_1 = m(x - x_1), \quad \frac{x}{a} + \frac{y}{b} = 1, \quad d = \frac{|a x_1 + b y_1 + c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}
description: Distance between parallel lines $a x + b y + c_1 = 0$ and $a x + b y + c_2 = 0$ is $d = \frac{|c_1 - c_2|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$.
examTip: Foot of perpendicular: $\frac{h-x_1}{a} = \frac{k-y_1}{b} = -\frac{a x_1 + b y_1 + c}{a^2+b^2}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Homogeneous 2nd Degree Pair & Angle
formula: a x^2 + 2 h x y + b y^2 = 0, \quad \tan\theta = \left| \frac{2\sqrt{h^2 - a b}}{a + b} \right|
description: Lines are perpendicular iff $a + b = 0$. Coincident iff $h^2 = a b$. Angle bisectors: $\frac{x^2-y^2}{a-b} = \frac{xy}{h}$.
examTip: General 2nd degree pair condition: $\Delta = a b c + 2 f g h - a f^2 - b g^2 - c h^2 = 0$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Equations, Tangent & Director Circle
formula: x^2 + y^2 + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0 \implies r = \sqrt{g^2+f^2-c}, \quad y = m x \pm r \sqrt{1+m^2}
description: Tangent at $(x_1, y_1)$: $x x_1 + y y_1 + g(x+x_1) + f(y+y_1) + c = 0$. Director circle of $x^2+y^2=r^2$ is $x^2+y^2=2r^2$.
examTip: Orthogonal circles condition: $2 g_1 g_2 + 2 f_1 f_2 = c_1 + c_2$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Parabola, Ellipse & Hyperbola Standard Forms
description: Parabola: LR $= 4a$, Focus $(a,0)$. Ellipse: $b^2 = a^2(1-e^2)$, LR $= 2b^2/a$. Hyperbola: $b^2 = a^2(e^2-1)$, LR $= 2b^2/a$.
examTip: Rectangular hyperbola $x^2 - y^2 = a^2$ or $x y = c^2$ has eccentricity $e = \sqrt{2}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Standard Limits, L'Hôpital & Continuity
description: Continuity at $a$: $\lim_{x \to a^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to a^+} f(x) = f(a)$. Form $1^\infty$: $e^{\lim g(x)[f(x)-1]}$.
examTip: $\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos x}{x^2} = \frac{1}{2}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Derivative Rules & Standard Forms
formula: \frac{d}{dx}(u v) = u v' + v u', \quad \frac{d}{dx}\left(\frac{u}{v}\right) = \frac{v u' - u v'}{v^2}, \quad \frac{d}{dx}f(g(x)) = f'(g(x)) g'(x)
description: Standard: $\frac{d}{dx}(\sin x) = \cos x, \frac{d}{dx}(\tan x) = \sec^2 x, \frac{d}{dx}(\ln x) = \frac{1}{x}, \frac{d}{dx}(\tan^{-1} x) = \frac{1}{1+x^2}$.
examTip: Implicit partial derivative shortcut: $\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{\partial F / \partial x}{\partial F / \partial y}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Tangents, Monotonicity & LMVT
formula: m_T = f'(x_1), \quad m_N = -\frac{1}{f'(x_1)}, \quad f'(c) = \frac{f(b) - f(a)}{b - a} \quad c \in (a,b)
description: Strictly Increasing: $f'(x) > 0$. Strictly Decreasing: $f'(x) < 0$. Second derivative test: $f''(c) < 0 \implies$ Local Max; $f''(c) > 0 \implies$ Local Min.
examTip: Subnormal for $y^2 = 4ax$ is constant $= 2a$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Standard Forms & Integration by Parts
formula: \int u dv = u v - \int v du, \quad \int e^x [f(x) + f'(x)] dx = e^x f(x) + C
description: Standard: $\int \frac{dx}{x^2+a^2} = \frac{1}{a}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{a}\right) + C, \int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{a^2-x^2}} = \sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{a}\right) + C$.
examTip: ILATE rule for choice of $u$: Inverse trig, Logarithmic, Algebraic, Trigonometric, Exponential.

subject: Mathematics
title: Properties & King's Rule
formula: \int_a^b f(x) dx = \int_a^b f(a+b-x) dx, \quad \int_{-a}^a f(x) dx = 2\int_0^a f(x) dx \text{ (Even)}; 0 \text{ (Odd)}
description: Walli's formula: $\int_0^{\pi/2} \sin^n x dx = \frac{(n-1)(n-3)...}{n(n-2)...} \times K$ ($K=\pi/2$ if $n$ even, else $1$).
examTip: Area bounded by two parabolas $y^2 = 4ax$ and $x^2 = 4by$ is $\frac{16ab}{3}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: First Order Linear & Variable Separable
formula: \frac{dy}{dx} + P(x) y = Q(x) \implies I F = e^{\int P dx}, \quad y \cdot (I F) = \int Q \cdot (I F) dx + C
description: Homogeneous DE $\frac{dy}{dx} = f(y/x) \implies$ substitute $y = v x$. Order = highest derivative, Degree = power of highest derivative.
examTip: Bernoulli's DE $\frac{dy}{dx} + P y = Q y^n \implies$ divide by $y^n$, substitute $v = y^{1-n}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Dot, Cross & Triple Products
description: BAC-CAB Rule: $\vec{a} \times (\vec{b} \times \vec{c}) = (\vec{a} \cdot \vec{c}) \vec{b} - (\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}) \vec{c}$. Vector projection of $\vec{a}$ on $\vec{b} = (\frac{\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}}{|\vec{b}|^2}) \vec{b}$.
examTip: Volume of parallelepiped $V = |[\vec{a} \, \vec{b} \, \vec{c}]|$. Coplanar iff $[\vec{a} \, \vec{b} \, \vec{c}] = 0$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Line, Plane & Shortest Distance
description: Plane form: $a x + b y + c z + d = 0$. Distance from $(x_1,y_1,z_1)$ to plane $= \frac{|a x_1 + b y_1 + c z_1 + d|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}}$.
examTip: Angle between line and plane: $\sin\phi = \frac{|a_1 a_2 + b_1 b_2 + c_1 c_2|}{\sqrt{\sum a_1^2}\sqrt{\sum a_2^2}}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Bayes' Theorem & Binomial Distribution
formula: P(E_k | A) = \frac{P(E_k) P(A | E_k)}{\sum P(E_i) P(A | E_i)}, \quad P(X = k) = {}^n C_k p^k q^{n-k}
description: Binomial Mean $= n p$, Variance $= n p q \implies \text{Mean} > \text{Variance}$. Standard Deviation $\sigma = \sqrt{npq}$.
examTip: Variance of first $n$ natural numbers $= (n^2 - 1) / 12$. Coefficient of Variation $CV = (\sigma / \bar{x}) \times 100$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Sets & Power Set Cardinality
description: Power set contains all subsets. Number of proper subsets = $2^n - 1$.
variables: $n = n(A)$: number of elements in set A
examTip: Number of subsets with at least $k$ elements = $\sum_{r=k}^n {}^n C_r$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Cartesian Product & Total Relations
formula: n(A \times B) = m \cdot n, \quad \text{Total Relations} = 2^{m n}
description: Cartesian product $A \times B = \{(a,b) : a \in A, b \in B\}$. Subset of $A \times B$ defines a relation.
examTip: Number of non-empty relations = $2^{mn} - 1$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Domain, Range & Composition
description: Domain of $f \circ g = \{x \in \text{Dom}(g) : g(x) \in \text{Dom}(f)\}$. Invertible iff one-one and onto.
examTip: If $f$ is bijective $\implies (f^{-1})^{-1} = f$ and $(f \circ g)^{-1} = g^{-1} \circ f^{-1}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Modulus, Argument & Euler Form
description: Conjugate $z \bar{z} = |z|^2$. Inverse $z^{-1} = \bar{z} / |z|^2$. Triangle inequality $||z_1|-|z_2|| \le |z_1 \pm z_2| \le |z_1|+|z_2|$.
examTip: Locus $|z - z_1| = |z - z_2|$ is perpendicular bisector of segment $z_1 z_2$.

subject: Mathematics
title: De Moivre's Theorem & Roots of Unity
description: Cube roots of unity $\omega = e^{i 2\pi/3} = -\frac{1}{2} + i\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$. Sum of $n$-th roots of unity $= 0$, Product $= (-1)^{n-1}$.
examTip: $1 + \omega^k + \omega^{2k} = 3$ if $3 \mid k$, else $0$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Roots, Discriminant & Vieta Formulas
description: Difference of roots $|\alpha - \beta| = \sqrt{D}/|a|$. Vertex at $x = -b/(2a), y = -D/(4a)$. $D < 0 \implies$ complex conjugate roots.
examTip: Condition for 1 common root: $(a_1 c_2 - a_2 c_1)^2 = (a_1 b_2 - a_2 b_1)(b_1 c_2 - b_2 c_1)$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Polynomial Roots & Transformation
description: Descartes Rule of Signs: Max positive real roots = sign changes in $P(x)$; Max negative real roots = sign changes in $P(-x)$.
examTip: Newton's sum method: $a S_n + b S_{n-1} + c S_{n-2} = 0$ for $S_n = \alpha^n + \beta^n$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Arrangements, Selections & Derangements
description: Pascal identity ${}^n C_r + {}^n C_{r-1} = {}^{n+1} C_r$. Circular permutations $(n-1)!$. Stars and bars ${}^{n+r-1} C_{r-1}$.
examTip: Polygon diagonals count $= \frac{n(n-3)}{2}$. Number of onto functions from $m \to n$ items $= \sum_{r=0}^n (-1)^{n-r} {}^n C_r r^m$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Expansion, General Term & Infinite Series
formula: (x+y)^n = \sum_{r=0}^n {}^n C_r x^{n-r} y^r, \quad T_{r+1} = {}^n C_r x^{n-r} y^r
description: Sum of coefficients $\sum C_r = 2^n$. Sum of squares $\sum C_r^2 = {}^{2n} C_n$. Infinite binomial $(1-x)^{-1} = 1 + x + x^2 + ... \infty$ for $|x| < 1$.
examTip: Multinomial terms count in $(x_1 + ... + x_k)^n$ is ${}^{n+k-1} C_{k-1}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Decomposition of Proper Rational Fractions
description: Degree $P(x) <$ Degree $Q(x)$. Heaviside cover-up method evaluates linear constants directly.
examTip: Irreducible quadratic factor $a x^2+b x+c \implies$ use numerator $A x + B$.

subject: Mathematics
title: AP, GP, HP & AGP Progressions
description: AM-GM-HM Inequality: $A \ge G \ge H$. $G^2 = A \cdot H$. Sum of squares $\sum k^2 = \frac{n(n+1)(2n+1)}{6}$, sum of cubes $\sum k^3 = [\frac{n(n+1)}{2}]^2$.
variables: a: first term, d: diff, r: ratio
examTip: Infinite AGP sum: $S_\infty = \frac{a}{1-r} + \frac{d r}{(1-r)^2}$ for $|r| < 1$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Line Equations, Distance & Angle Bisectors
formula: y - y_1 = m(x - x_1), \quad \frac{x}{a} + \frac{y}{b} = 1, \quad d = \frac{|a x_1 + b y_1 + c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}
description: Parallel distance $d = \frac{|c_1-c_2|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$. Foot of perpendicular $\frac{h-x_1}{a} = \frac{k-y_1}{b} = -\frac{a x_1 + b y_1 + c}{a^2+b^2}$.
examTip: Image of point $(x_1, y_1)$ in line: $\frac{h-x_1}{a} = \frac{k-y_1}{b} = -2 \frac{a x_1 + b y_1 + c}{a^2+b^2}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Homogeneous 2nd Degree Pair & General Form
formula: a x^2 + 2 h x y + b y^2 = 0, \quad \tan\theta = \left| \frac{2\sqrt{h^2 - a b}}{a + b} \right|
description: Perpendicular lines iff $a+b=0$. Coincident iff $h^2=ab$. Angle bisectors $\frac{x^2-y^2}{a-b} = \frac{xy}{h}$.
examTip: General 2nd degree pair condition: $\Delta = a b c + 2 f g h - a f^2 - b g^2 - c h^2 = 0$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Standard, General & System of Circles
formula: x^2 + y^2 + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0 \implies r = \sqrt{g^2+f^2-c}, \quad y = m x \pm r \sqrt{1+m^2}
description: Tangent at $(x_1, y_1)$: $x x_1 + y y_1 + g(x+x_1) + f(y+y_1) + c = 0$. Director circle $x^2+y^2=2r^2$. Orthogonal condition $2 g_1 g_2 + 2 f_1 f_2 = c_1 + c_2$.
examTip: Radical axis of two circles $S_1, S_2$ is $S_1 - S_2 = 0$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Co-axial Circles & Radical Axis
description: Radical axis is perpendicular to line joining centers. Limiting points of co-axial system are $(-\sqrt{c}, 0)$ and $(\sqrt{c}, 0)$ for $c > 0$.
examTip: Common chord of two intersecting circles $S_1, S_2$ is $S_1 - S_2 = 0$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Standard Parabola $y^2 = 4ax$ & Tangent Forms
formula: y^2 = 4ax, \quad y = m x + \frac{a}{m}, \quad t y = x + a t^2
description: Focus $(a,0)$, Directrix $x=-a$, LR $= 4a$. Focal chord $t_1 t_2 = -1$. Normal in slope form $y = m x - 2am - am^3$.
examTip: Intersection of perpendicular tangents lies on directrix $x = -a$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Standard Ellipse $\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1$ & Properties
formula: \frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1, \quad e = \sqrt{1 - \frac{b^2}{a^2}}, \quad y = m x \pm \sqrt{a^2 m^2 + b^2}
description: Foci $(\pm ae, 0)$, Directrices $x = \pm a/e$, LR $= 2b^2/a$. Sum of focal distances $SP + S'P = 2a$. Director circle $x^2+y^2=a^2+b^2$.
examTip: Area of ellipse $= \pi a b$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Standard & Conjugate Hyperbola
formula: \frac{x^2}{a^2} - \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1, \quad e = \sqrt{1 + \frac{b^2}{a^2}}, \quad y = m x \pm \sqrt{a^2 m^2 - b^2}
description: Foci $(\pm ae, 0)$, Directrices $x = \pm a/e$, LR $= 2b^2/a$. Difference of focal distances $|SP - S'P| = 2a$. Asymptotes $y = \pm (b/a)x$.
examTip: Rectangular hyperbola $x^2 - y^2 = a^2$ or $x y = c^2$ has eccentricity $e = \sqrt{2}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Standard Formulas & Special Techniques
formula: \int u dv = u v - \int v du, \quad \int e^x [f(x) + f'(x)] dx = e^x f(x) + C
description: Standard: $\int \frac{dx}{x^2+a^2} = \frac{1}{a}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{a}\right), \int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{a^2-x^2}} = \sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{a}\right), \int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{x^2 \pm a^2}} = \ln|x + \sqrt{x^2 \pm a^2}|$.
examTip: ILATE rule for choice of $u$: Inverse trig, Logarithmic, Algebraic, Trigonometric, Exponential.

subject: Mathematics
title: Properties, King's Rule & Walli Formula
formula: \int_a^b f(x) dx = \int_a^b f(a+b-x) dx, \quad \int_{-a}^a f(x) dx = 2\int_0^a f(x) dx \text{ (Even)}; 0 \text{ (Odd)}
description: Walli formula: $\int_0^{\pi/2} \sin^n x dx = \frac{(n-1)(n-3)...}{n(n-2)...} \times K$ ($K=\pi/2$ if $n$ even, else $1$). Leibniz rule: $\frac{d}{dx}\int_{g(x)}^{h(x)} f(t) dt = f(h)h' - f(g)g'$.
examTip: $\int_0^{\pi/2} \ln(\sin x) dx = -\frac{\pi}{2} \ln 2$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Area Bounded by Curves
description: Area between parabola $y^2 = 4ax$ and line $y = mx$ is $\frac{8a^2}{3m^3}$. Area between two parabolas $y^2=4ax$ and $x^2=4by$ is $\frac{16ab}{3}$.
examTip: Area of ellipse $\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1$ is $\pi a b$. Area of circle $x^2+y^2=r^2$ is $\pi r^2$.

subject: Mathematics
title: First Order DE Methods & Linear Form
formula: \frac{dy}{dx} + P(x) y = Q(x) \implies I F = e^{\int P dx}, \quad y \cdot (I F) = \int Q \cdot (I F) dx + C
description: Homogeneous DE $\frac{dy}{dx} = f(y/x) \implies y = v x$. Exact DE $M dx + N dy = 0 \iff \frac{\partial M}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial N}{\partial x}$.
examTip: Bernoulli DE $\frac{dy}{dx} + P y = Q y^n \implies$ divide by $y^n$, substitute $v = y^{1-n}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Line, Plane & Shortest Distance
description: Plane form: $a x + b y + c z + d = 0$. Distance from $(x_1,y_1,z_1)$ to plane $= \frac{|a x_1 + b y_1 + c z_1 + d|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}}$. Sphere: $x^2+y^2+z^2+2ux+2vy+2wz+d=0$.
examTip: Angle between line and plane: $\sin\phi = \frac{|a_1 a_2 + b_1 b_2 + c_1 c_2|}{\sqrt{\sum a_1^2}\sqrt{\sum a_2^2}}$.

subject: Mathematics
title: Dot, Cross & Triple Products
description: BAC-CAB Rule: $\vec{a} \times (\vec{b} \times \vec{c}) = (\vec{a} \cdot \vec{c}) \vec{b} - (\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}) \vec{c}$. Vector projection of $\vec{a}$ on $\vec{b} = (\frac{\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}}{|\vec{b}|^2}) \vec{b}$.
examTip: Volume of parallelepiped $V = |[\vec{a} \, \vec{b} \, \vec{c}]|$. Coplanar iff $[\vec{a} \, \vec{b} \, \vec{c}] = 0$.

subject: Mathematics
title: LPP Formulation & Corner Point Theorem
formula: Z = a x + b y \quad (\text{Optimize}), \quad a_i x + b_i y \le c_i, \quad x \ge 0, y \ge 0
description: Corner Point Theorem: Optimal value of objective function $Z$ occurs at one of the corner points (vertices) of the feasible region.
examTip: Multiple optimal solutions occur when two adjacent vertices yield the same optimal $Z$ value.

subject: Mathematics
title: Bayes Theorem, Distribution & Variance
formula: P(E_k | A) = \frac{P(E_k) P(A | E_k)}{\sum P(E_i) P(A | E_i)}, \quad P(X = k) = {}^n C_k p^k q^{n-k}
description: Binomial Mean $= n p$, Variance $= n p q \implies \text{Mean} > \text{Variance}$. Variance of first $n$ natural numbers $= (n^2 - 1) / 12$.
examTip: Coefficient of Variation $CV = (\sigma / \bar{x}) \times 100$. Lower CV $\implies$ higher consistency.

subject: Physics
title: SI Units & Dimensional Formulas
description: Principle of Homogeneity: LHS and RHS dimensions must be equal. Error propagation: $\frac{\Delta Z}{Z} = p \frac{\Delta A}{A} + q \frac{\Delta B}{B}$.
variables: G: gravitational constant, h: Planck constant
examTip: Absolute errors always ADD in sum and difference: $\Delta Z = \Delta A + \Delta B$.

subject: Physics
title: 1D Motion Equations & Relative Speed
formula: v = u + a t, \quad s = u t + \frac{1}{2} a t^2, \quad v^2 = u^2 + 2 a s, \quad s_n = u + \frac{a}{2}(2n - 1)
description: Galileo odd numbers law for free fall $1:3:5:7...$. Max height $H = u^2/(2g)$, Time of flight $T = 2u/g$. Relative speed in 1D $v_{rel} = v_A \pm v_B$.
variables: u: initial velocity, a: acceleration, t: time
examTip: Kinematic 3 equations apply ONLY when acceleration $a$ is CONSTANT.

subject: Physics
title: Oblique Projectile & Circular Motion
formula: T = \frac{2 u \sin\theta}{g}, \quad H_{\max} = \frac{u^2 \sin^2\theta}{2g}, \quad R = \frac{u^2 \sin 2\theta}{g}, \quad a_c = \frac{v^2}{r} = \omega^2 r
description: Trajectory $y = x \tan\theta - \frac{g x^2}{2 u^2 \cos^2\theta}$. Range is max at $\theta = 45^\circ$. Complementary angles $\theta$ and $90^\circ - \theta$ give SAME range.
variables: u: projection speed, \theta: angle, r: radius
examTip: Centripetal force does ZERO work ($W=0$) because force is perpendicular to velocity.

subject: Physics
title: Newton's Laws, Friction & Banking
formula: F_{net} = m a, \quad f_s \le \mu_s N, \quad f_k = \mu_k N, \quad v_{\max} = \sqrt{r g \frac{\mu_s + \tan\theta}{1 - \mu_s \tan\theta}}
description: Apparent weight in elevator $N = m(g \pm a)$. Angle of repose $\tan\theta = \mu_s$. Atwood machine $a = \frac{m_2 - m_1}{m_1 + m_2} g$.
variables: m: mass, \mu: friction coeff, N: normal force
examTip: Optimum speed on banked road without friction dependency: $v = \sqrt{r g \tan\theta}$.

subject: Physics
title: Work-Energy Theorem & Collisions
formula: W_{net} = \Delta K = \frac{1}{2}m v^2 - \frac{1}{2}m u^2, \quad P = \vec{F} \cdot \vec{v}, \quad e = \frac{v_2 - v_1}{u_1 - u_2}
description: Spring potential energy $U = \frac{1}{2} k x^2$. Force-Potential relation $F = -\frac{dU}{dx}$. Elastic collision $e=1$, Inelastic $0 < e < 1$, Perfectly inelastic $e=0$.
variables: W: work, K: kinetic energy, e: restitution
examTip: 1D Elastic collision of equal masses $m_1 = m_2$: velocities INTERCHANGE ($v_1 = u_2, v_2 = u_1$).

subject: Physics
title: Moment of Inertia, Torque & Pure Rolling
formula: I = \sum m_i r_i^2, \quad \tau = I \alpha, \quad L = I \omega, \quad K_{rot} = \frac{1}{2} I \omega^2
description: Parallel axis theorem $I = I_{cm} + M d^2$. Perpendicular axis theorem $I_z = I_x + I_y$ (2D lamina). Pure rolling $v_{cm} = R \omega, a_{cm} = R \alpha$.
variables: I: moment of inertia, \tau: torque, L: angular momentum
examTip: Moment of inertia: Solid sphere $2/5 M R^2$, Disc $1/2 M R^2$, Ring $M R^2$, Shell $2/3 M R^2$.

subject: Physics
title: Kepler Laws, Variation of g & Escape Speed
formula: F = \frac{G M m}{r^2}, \quad g_h = g\left(1 - \frac{2h}{R}\right), \quad v_e = \sqrt{\frac{2 G M}{R}} = \sqrt{2 g R}
description: Orbital speed $v_o = \sqrt{\frac{G M}{r}}$. Relation $v_e = \sqrt{2} v_o \approx 11.2 \text{ km/s}$. Kepler's 3rd law $T^2 \propto r^3$. Geostationary height $h \approx 36000 \text{ km}$.
variables: G: gravitational constant, R: Earth radius
examTip: Binding energy of satellite in circular orbit $E_{total} = -\frac{G M m}{2r} = -K = \frac{1}{2} U$.

subject: Physics
title: Elasticity, Viscosity & Surface Tension
formula: Y = \frac{\text{Stress}}{\text{Strain}} = \frac{F L}{A \Delta L}, \quad v_t = \frac{2 r^2 (\rho - \sigma) g}{9 \eta}, \quad h = \frac{2 T \cos\theta}{r \rho g}
description: Bulk modulus $B = -\frac{\Delta P}{\Delta V/V}$. Excess pressure in soap bubble $\Delta P = \frac{4T}{R}$ (liquid drop $\Delta P = \frac{2T}{R}$). Bernoulli law $P + \frac{1}{2}\rho v^2 + \rho g y = \text{const}$.
variables: Y: Young's modulus, \eta: viscosity, T: surface tension
examTip: Terminal velocity is directly proportional to the SQUARE of radius ($v_t \propto r^2$).

subject: Physics
title: Heat Transfer, First Law & Carnot Engine
formula: \Delta Q = \Delta U + W, \quad W_{iso} = n R T \ln\left(\frac{V_2}{V_1}\right), \quad \eta = 1 - \frac{T_2}{T_1}
description: First law $\Delta U = q + w$. Adiabatic process $P V^\gamma = \text{const}, W = \frac{P_1 V_1 - P_2 V_2}{\gamma - 1}$. Stefan law $P = \varepsilon \sigma A T^4$. Wien displacement law $\lambda_{max} T = b$.
examTip: Mayer's relation $C_p - C_v = R$. Monatomic $\gamma = 1.67$, Diatomic $\gamma = 1.40$.

subject: Physics
title: Molecular Speeds & Degrees of Freedom
formula: v_{rms} = \sqrt{\frac{3 R T}{M}}, \quad v_{avg} = \sqrt{\frac{8 R T}{\pi M}}, \quad v_{mp} = \sqrt{\frac{2 R T}{M}}, \quad U = \frac{f}{2} n R T
description: Equipartition law: Energy per degree of freedom per molecule $= \frac{1}{2} k_B T$. Pressure $P = \frac{1}{3} \rho v_{rms}^2$. $\gamma = 1 + \frac{2}{f}$.
variables: f: degrees of freedom, M: molar mass
examTip: Speed ratio RAM: $v_{rms} > v_{avg} > v_{mp}$ ($1.225 : 1.128 : 1.000$).

subject: Physics
title: Simple Harmonic Motion & Pendulum
formula: a = -\omega^2 x, \quad x(t) = A \sin(\omega t + \phi), \quad T = 2\pi \sqrt{\frac{m}{k}}, \quad T = 2\pi \sqrt{\frac{L}{g}}
description: Velocity $v = \omega \sqrt{A^2 - x^2}$. Total energy $E = \frac{1}{2} m \omega^2 A^2$. Position where $K=U$ is $x = \pm A/\sqrt{2}$.
examTip: Frequency of energy oscillation ($K$ or $U$) is DOUBLE the frequency of SHM displacement ($2f$).

subject: Physics
title: Wave Equation, Sound Speed & Doppler Effect
formula: y(x,t) = A \sin(k x - \omega t), \quad v = \sqrt{\frac{T}{\mu}}, \quad f' = f \left(\frac{v \pm v_o}{v \mp v_s}\right)
description: Speed of sound in gas $v = \sqrt{\frac{\gamma P}{\rho}}$. Organ pipes: Open $f_n = n \frac{v}{2L}$ (all harmonics); Closed $f_n = (2n-1)\frac{v}{4L}$ (odd harmonics). Beats $f_{beat} = |f_1 - f_2|$.
variables: v: sound speed, v_o: observer, v_s: source
examTip: Closed organ pipe produces ONLY odd harmonics ($1:3:5...$).

subject: Physics
title: Coulomb Law, Field, Potential & Capacitors
formula: F = \frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0}\frac{|q_1 q_2|}{r^2}, \quad E = -\frac{dV}{dr}, \quad C = \frac{\varepsilon_0 A}{d}, \quad U = \frac{1}{2} C V^2
description: Gauss law $\oint \vec{E} \cdot d\vec{A} = \frac{Q_{enc}}{\varepsilon_0}$. Short dipole field: Axial $E = \frac{2 k p}{r^3}$, Equatorial $E = \frac{k p}{r^3}$. Dielectric insertion $C' = K C_0$.
examTip: Electric field inside a hollow conducting sphere is strictly ZERO ($E_{in} = 0$).

subject: Physics
title: Ohm's Law, Resistivity & Potentiometer
formula: V = I R, \quad R = \rho \frac{L}{A}, \quad v_d = \frac{e E \tau}{m}, \quad I = n e A v_d, \quad P_{max} = \frac{\mathcal{E}^2}{4r}
description: Wheatstone bridge balance $P/Q = R/S$. Meter bridge $R/S = l/(100-l)$. Potentiometer internal resistance $r = R(l_1/l_2 - 1)$. Stretched wire $L' = n L \implies R' = n^2 R$.
examTip: Max power transfer theorem: Power delivered to load $R$ is maximum when load matches internal resistance ($R = r$).

subject: Physics
title: Lorentz Force, Biot-Savart & Cyclotron
formula: \vec{F} = q(\vec{v} \times \vec{B}), \quad r = \frac{m v}{q B}, \quad B_{\text{wire}} = \frac{\mu_0 I}{2\pi r}, \quad B_{\text{loop}} = \frac{\mu_0 N I}{2 R}
description: Biot-Savart law $d\vec{B} = \frac{\mu_0}{4\pi} \frac{I d\vec{l} \times \hat{r}}{r^2}$. Ampere law $\oint \vec{B} \cdot d\vec{l} = \mu_0 I$. Parallel wires force per length $F/L = \frac{\mu_0 I_1 I_2}{2\pi d}$.
variables: B: magnetic field, q: charge, v: speed
examTip: Magnetic force does ZERO work ($W=0$) on moving charge because force is perpendicular to velocity.

subject: Physics
title: Earth's Magnetism & Magnetic Materials
formula: B_H = B_e \cos\delta, \quad B_V = B_e \sin\delta, \quad \tan\delta = \frac{B_V}{B_H}, \quad B = \mu_0 H(1 + \chi_m)
description: Diamagnetic $\chi_m < 0, \mu_r < 1$. Paramagnetic $\chi_m > 0, \mu_r > 1$. Ferromagnetic $\chi_m \gg 1, \mu_r \gg 1$. Curie law $\chi \propto 1/T$.
examTip: At magnetic equator $\delta = 0^\circ \implies B_V = 0$. At poles $\delta = 90^\circ \implies B_H = 0$.

subject: Physics
title: Faraday's Law, Motional EMF & Inductance
formula: \mathcal{E} = -N \frac{d\Phi_B}{dt}, \quad \mathcal{E}_{rot} = \frac{1}{2} B \omega L^2, \quad L = \frac{\mu_0 N^2 A}{l}, \quad U = \frac{1}{2} L I^2
description: Motional EMF $\mathcal{E} = B L v$. Lenz law reflects energy conservation. Mutual inductance $M = k \sqrt{L_1 L_2}$. Induced charge $q = \Delta\Phi_B / R$.
examTip: AC generator peak EMF $\mathcal{E}_0 = N B A \omega$.

subject: Physics
title: Reactance, Impedance & LCR Resonance
formula: X_L = \omega L, \quad X_C = \frac{1}{\omega C}, \quad Z = \sqrt{R^2 + (X_L - X_C)^2}, \quad f_0 = \frac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{LC}}
description: RMS values $V_{rms} = V_0/\sqrt{2}, I_{rms} = I_0/\sqrt{2}$. Average power $P_{avg} = V_{rms} I_{rms} \cos\phi$. Quality factor $Q = \frac{\omega_0 L}{R} = \frac{1}{R}\sqrt{\frac{L}{C}}$. Transformer ratio $V_s/V_p = N_s/N_p = I_p/I_s$.
examTip: At series resonance ($X_L = X_C$), $Z_{min} = R$, current is maximum $I_{max} = V/R$, power factor $\cos\phi = 1$.

subject: Physics
title: Maxwell Equations & Speed of Light
description: Total energy density $u = \frac{1}{2}\varepsilon_0 E_0^2 = \frac{B_0^2}{2\mu_0}$. Poynting vector $\vec{S} = \frac{1}{\mu_0} (\vec{E} \times \vec{B})$. Radiation pressure $P = I/c$.
variables: I_d: displacement current, c: speed of light
examTip: EM waves are transverse non-mechanical waves; $\vec{E}$ and $\vec{B}$ oscillate in phase perpendicular to propagation.

subject: Physics
title: Mirrors, Lenses, Prism & Telescope
description: Snell law $\mu_1 \sin i = \mu_2 \sin r$. Critical angle $\sin i_c = 1/\mu$. Prism formula $\mu = \frac{\sin((A+D_m)/2)}{\sin(A/2)}$. Astronomical telescope magnification $M = -f_o / f_e$, length $L = f_o + f_e$.
examTip: Lens power $P = 1/f(\text{m})$ Diopters. Contact lenses $P_{eq} = P_1 + P_2$.

subject: Physics
title: Interference, Diffraction & Polarization
formula: \beta = \frac{\lambda D}{d}, \quad I = 4 I_0 \cos^2(\phi/2), \quad a \sin\theta = n \lambda \text{ (Diffraction Minima)}
description: YDSE bright fringe $y_n = n \lambda D / d$, dark fringe $y'_n = (2n-1)\lambda D / (2d)$. Single slit central max width $\beta_0 = 2 \lambda D / a$. Brewster law $\tan i_p = \mu$. Malus law $I = I_0 \cos^2\theta$.
examTip: Central diffraction maximum width is TWICE the width of secondary maxima.

subject: Physics
title: Photoelectric Effect & de Broglie Wavelength
formula: h \nu = \phi_0 + K_{\max} = h \nu_0 + e V_0, \quad \lambda = \frac{h}{p} = \frac{h}{\sqrt{2 m e V}} = \frac{12.27}{\sqrt{V}} \text{ \AA}
description: Photon energy $E = h \nu = hc/\lambda \approx 12400 / \lambda(\text{\AA}) \text{ eV}$. Stopping potential $V_0$ depends ONLY on frequency, independent of intensity. Current depends on intensity.
variables: V_0: stopping potential, \lambda: de Broglie wavelength
examTip: Davisson-Germer experiment proved wave nature of electrons through Nickel crystal diffraction ($V=54\text{V}, \lambda=1.66\text{\AA}$).

subject: Physics
title: Bohr Atomic Model & Hydrogen Lines
description: Rydberg formula $1/\lambda = R Z^2 (1/n_1^2 - 1/n_2^2)$. Lyman (UV, $n_1=1$), Balmer (Visible, $n_1=2$), Paschen (IR, $n_1=3$). Angular momentum quantization $m v r = n h / (2\pi)$.
variables: n: principal quantum number, Z: atomic number
examTip: Total spectral lines emitted from level $n$ to ground state: $N = n(n-1)/2$.

subject: Physics
title: Nuclear Radius, Binding Energy & Decay
formula: R = R_0 A^{1/3}, \quad E_b = \Delta m (\text{amu}) \times 931.5 \text{ MeV}, \quad N(t) = N_0 e^{-\lambda t}
description: Half-life $T_{1/2} = \frac{0.693}{\lambda}$. Mean life $\tau = 1/\lambda = 1.44 T_{1/2}$. Nuclear density $\rho \approx 2.3 \times 10^{17} \text{ kg/m}^3$ is CONSTANT for all nuclei. Max $E_b/A$ at Fe-56 ($8.75 \text{ MeV}$).
examTip: Nuclear force is short-range, charge-independent, and non-central.

variables: n_i: intrinsic carrier density, \beta: CE current gain

title: Precipitate: Silver Chloride (AgCl)
